questions.text: Which substance, property or deviation must be detected, and how is off-spec defined today?
Is the liquid clear, turbid or opaque at the measurement point, and does it change?
Roughly what concentration level is expected: main component (percent range) or traces below about 0.1 %?
Can deposits form at the probe window, and how is the line cleaned (CIP, temperature, chemicals)?
Which physical and formulation changes occur between runs (temperature, texture, particle size, air bubbles, recipe)?
What temperature, pressure and flow occur at the measurement point?
Which independent reference method and sampling time can be used?
What concentration range, accuracy and response time must the measurement meet?
